title: When logic says “stay in the boat”…
paragraphs:
When logic says “stay in the boat”…
Faith whispers, “Step out. I’ve got you.”
Every miracle begins with a step you can’t explain —
Trust God enough to take yours today. 🌊✨

Matthew 14:29 (NIV)
“Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.”
